A few helpful details

Frequently asked questions.

Can the design reflect our culture and traditions?

Yes. Your story, culture, colours and ceremonies guide the design. We’ll discuss the details that matter to you during your consultation.

Can we include both our traditional and white wedding?

Yes. The Celebration Experience can organise multiple event sections within one website. If you want a separate private dashboard for RSVPs and gift records, ask about the Complete Wedding Experience.

How does the private couple dashboard work?

The Complete package is planned to include a private, password-protected area for RSVP management and gift records. Its live functionality will be confirmed in your project scope before purchase.

Can guests send money through the website?

The website can present your preferred gifting information. Online payments and automatic reconciliation need a supported payment integration and will only be offered when available and confirmed.

When does delivery time begin?

After payment is confirmed and all required text, photos and wedding details have been received. Delays in content or major changes may affect delivery.

How do we get started?

Choose a package, complete the enquiry form below and book a consultation. We’ll confirm scope, timeline and payment terms before work begins.
